title: Projektetage Pdf Fullscreen Size
summary:
PDF slide fullscreen on projektetage (Medienüberblick) kept rendering at the declared catalogue frame size because react-pdf measured `.presentation-disposition-frame` and never re-bound to the expanded fullscreen content box.

Fix: `PresentationDispositionFullscreenContext` drives `usePdfPageSize` to observe the fullscreen content area and fall back to `SLIDE_INTERACTIVE_FULLSCREEN_FRAME` fractions; interactive fullscreen strips nested `position` so the PDF is not double-framed; CSS makes pdf morph-anchor/document fill the fullscreen content. Regression test added. 70 renderer tests pass.
